observations: Photo 0: a dismantled automatic transmission unit with torque converter attached, lying on a paved/brick floor, covered in dust and grime, with a white sticker showing a number '460' and some illegible text above it.
Photo 1: close-up of the torque converter bell-housing face, showing wear marks and oil residue around the bolt holes.
Photo 2: the transmission casing viewed from the side, hung near a wall with visible dark oil staining/drips on the wall above it, suggesting fluid leakage either from the unit or from handling.
No manufacturer logo, part number, or 'M278'/'G63' marking is legible in any photo.
No visible test rig, dipstick, or video showing the unit running.

identity.kind: automatic transmission / gearbox assembly (claimed Mercedes-Benz type)

claims.evidence: No Mercedes logo or stamped plate readable in photo 0, 1, or 2.
Sticker in photo 0 shows only a partial number '460'; no legible 'M278' or 'G63' marking visible.
Origin cannot be confirmed from photos; no shipping or customs documentation shown.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: No test video, dipstick check, or bench-run footage provided; unit appears dusty and used.

risks.risk: Possible internal wear or failure (claimed 'no knock' unproven)
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox running on a test stand or in a vehicle showing smooth shifting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / unverified condition

risks.risk: Fluid leak suggested by oil staining near the unit in photo 2
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals and a clean-surface test showing no leakage after standing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as leaking / needing seal replacement

risks.risk: Exact model/fitment (M278 G63) not confirmed, affecting value tier
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped ID plate or casting number matching M278 1282.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unverified used automatic gearbox, not as a premium AMG unit

risks.risk: Possible prior disassembly or repair despite 'never opened' claim
risks.proof: Photo of untouched bolt-seal paint markers or factory seals.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the stamped ID/part number plate or casting markings confirming M278 1282 / G63 fitment.
Video of the gearbox being tested (engine running, shifting through gears) before removal.
Close-up photos of all seals and mating surfaces to check for leaks.
Any import/customs documentation showing Belgian origin, if available.
response.reason: The photos show a genuine used automatic transmission assembly, but none of the seller's claims (brand, model, condition, origin) can be confirmed from the images, so it must be priced at the worst case as a generic unverified used gearbox rather than a premium G63 unit.
